newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Hungarian Defence Minister Gyorgy Keleti received an invitation for the Madrid NATO summit to meet his U.S. counterpart there.
-- The government decided to grant five billion forints for the treatment of cancer but the amount will be sufficient only for treating three-fourth of the persons in need of it.
-- A train journey between Budapest and Vienna takes only two hours from today.
-- The members of a National Election Task Group, set up to prepare for the 1998 elections and a referendum on potential NATO membership, swore in.
